meta.promptText: Indian winters mein dry skin ke liye konsa moisturizer kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Indian winters mein **dry skin** ke liye aapko **rich cream-based moisturizer** lena chahiye, na ki light gel ya watery lotion. Look for **ceramides, hyaluronic acid, glycerin, shea butter, aur panthenol**—ye ingredients skin ko deeply hydrate karte hain aur moisture lock karte hain.[3][5][10][12][13]

Agar aapko directly product choose karna ho, to in types ko prefer karein:
- **Very dry / flaky skin:** **CeraVe Moisturizing Cream** type ka thick, fragrance-free cream suit karta hai.[4][6][7]
- **Dry but not extremely flaky skin:** **Cetaphil** ya similar hydrating cream/lotion with **glycerin + hyaluronic acid** achha option hota hai.[13]
- **Sensitive dry skin:** **Fragrance-free, non-comedogenic** formula lein.[3][13]

Buying tip:
- **Cream > lotion > gel** for winter dry skin.[5][10][12]
- Moisturizer **nahaane/face wash ke turant baad** lagayein, jab skin thodi damp ho.[3][10][13]
- Din mein **2 baar** use karein agar skin bahut dry ho.[3][10]

Agar aap chahen, main aapke **budget** ke hisaab se 5 best options bhi shortlist kar sakta hoon: **under ₹500, ₹1000, ya premium**.
